note: GCB Bank's tariff guide (effective 15 July 2026), its retail banking section: a current account's monthly service charge is 20 cedis, with no minimum balance; the guide's tariffs exclude VAT, whose rate it doesn't give, so the fee is written before tax.

sources.title: GCB Bank, 2026 Tariff Guide (effective 15 July 2026), linked from its home page through a time-limited document link
sources.said: Please note that all tariffs are VAT exclusive ... EFFECTIVE 15TH JULY 2026 ... RETAIL BANKING ... 2. Current Account ... Initial Deposit ... Minimum Balance ... Monthly Service Charge / COT ... 100.00 ... 0.00 ... 20.00
